english.title: Vehicle - keep an unlicensed vehicle and fail to inform Secretary of State
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the keeper of a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was unlicensed and in respect of which a period of twelve months had elapsed throughout which that vehicle had been kept in Great Britain unlicensed, you failed to deliver the required declaration and particulars in relation to the vehicle to the Secretary of State
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 5 of Schedule 4 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(a) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
